text.scene: Fixed eye-level shot of a sunny backyard patio. On the left third of the frame stands a woman with a brown ponytail in a light blue blouse, beige trousers and green gloves, filling about 80% of the frame height, shown in profile facing screen right toward the plants, holding a green metal watering can in her right hand in front of her chest. In the centre-right lower part of the frame, closer to the camera than the woman, stands a long rectangular terracotta pot with leafy green plants (basil, mint, red geraniums) growing on top of it. On the front face of the pot, in the foreground nearest the camera, a large garden snail with a glossy brown striped spiral shell clings near the left end of the pot, at the lower centre of the frame, about 12% of the frame height, facing screen right.
timeline: The woman in the light blue blouse tilts the green watering can and waters the plants in the terracotta pot, a stream of water falling onto the leaves; the brown-shelled snail crawls along the front of the pot from its left end toward the right, sliding slowly to the right.

The woman in the light blue blouse keeps watering the plants, moving the spout gently over the basil and geraniums while water drips from the leaves; the brown-shelled snail keeps crawling along the front of the pot, now in the middle of the pot, moving from the left side to the right side of the frame.

The woman in the light blue blouse continues to water the plants with the green watering can; the brown-shelled snail keeps crawling along the pot until it reaches the right part of the pot's front face near the right side of the frame.
constraints: exactly one woman, one watering can, one pot of plants and one snail
the woman stays on the left and keeps watering the plants for the whole shot
the snail stays on the front face of the pot the whole time and crawls from left to right
no other people or animals, no on-screen text, fixed camera

intent.expressiveness_reason: Positions, the held watering can and the snail's crawl along the pot are in the proxies; the pouring water and the woman's watering gesture are text only.

notes: Snail is a large garden snail placed close to the camera on the front face of a long planter so that it is visible; the woman stands behind-left of the planter holding the watering can for the whole shot.
